result.title: EctD T212S：35°C 条件下的产物滴度与动力学
result.researchQuestion: Determination of the properties of mutant T212S using tetrahydropyrimidine as a substrate.

findings.claim: Under cultivation at 35°C for 48 hours, the hydroxy-tetrahydropyrimidine titer is 4.10 g/L, specific activity is 2.20 U/mg, product yield is 0.50 g/g substrate, and volumetric productivity is 0.0854166667 g/L/h.
Compared to P117, the titer is lower, but the yield and specific activity are higher.
Hydroxy-tetrahydropyrimidine titer reached 4.10 g/L after 48 hours of cultivation at 35°C.
Mutant T212S has a Km of 0.55 mM when using tetrahydropyrimidine as a substrate at a measurement temperature of 35°C.
The Km for mutant T212S with tetrahydropyrimidine is 0.55 mM at 35°C.
